title.zh: Stripe to expand stablecoin cards to over 100 countries by the end of the year
title.en: Stripe to expand stablecoin cards to over 100 countries by the end of the year

current_state.zh: Stripe is expanding its stablecoin card programs to more than 100 countries by the end of the year, appointing Privy CEO Henri Stern to oversee stablecoins and crypto, as stablecoin card spending tripled to roughly $1.2 billion last month.
